newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-MARLINS CENTERFIELDER WHITE TO MISS MONTH, KNEE INJURY.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-MARLINS CENTERFIELDER WHITE TO MISS MONTH, KNEE INJURY.

text.p: The struggling Florida Marlins got some bad news Friday when they learned that centre fielder Devon White has torn cartilage in his left knee and will miss at least one month of the season.
The 34-year-old White will have surgery on Saturday, the club said.
Marlins officials were unsure exactly when White suffered the injury, but the knee had been bothering him for a week and the cartilage tear was discovered during an examination on Thursday.

The Marlins placed White on the 15-day disabled list, retroactive to April 24, and replaced him on the roster by purchasing the contract of veteran utilityman John Wehner from Charlotte of the International League (AAA).
Moises Alou is scheduled to start in centre field Friday night against the Los Angeles Dodgers with Jim Eisenreich moving into the starting lineup in left field.
The Marlins have lost eight of their last 10 games since opening the season 8-1. The team completed a winless five-game road trip Wednesday in Colorado.
White, a seven-time Gold Glove winner for his defensive skills, was hitting .245 with six doubles and five RBI this season and was second on the team with 13 walks.
Wehner, 29, has played in 16 games for Charlotte and hit .222 with two homers and five RBI.
